title: Area-code org enumeration shard A pass 21

data.research_question: Which current public anarchist, anti-authoritarian, autonomous, Food Not Bombs, mutual-aid, collective and closely adjacent organizations are discoverable in shard-A NPAs 630, 636, 645 and 651?
data.method: Deterministic NPA shard-A enumeration with literal area-code queries, locality-derived queries, current-status verification, repository dedupe, historical-lead current-status checks, and public organizational communications enumeration.
classification_rules: Use only current in-service U.S. geographic NPAs where integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.
Historical directories are discovery seeds and do not establish current activity without fresh corroboration.
Area-code relations represent covered locality/discovery geography and do not assert telephone-number ownership.
Reuse canonical organization identities when already present; do not merge on name similarity alone.
No private membership inference or person-level political/ideological affiliation profiling.

unresolved_leads: Aurora-area affinity and collective groups with insufficient current organizational evidence

St. Charles County locality searches produced civic/advocacy groups but no mature current anarchist/FNB/mutual-aid collective identity meeting this workflow's inclusion threshold; STL Mutual Aid is centered outside the 636 locality and was not forced into this code
